audit_metadata.institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
audit_metadata.milestone: Phase 5 Step 0 — Independent Multi-Agent Architecture Readiness Audit
audit_metadata.audit_type: Strictly Independent, Read-Only Architectural, Cryptographic, and Governance Readiness Verification

git_baseline_status.reconciliation_summary: Pristine working tree adhering strictly to project governance. Only backend/app/models/__init__.py existed in baseline HEAD and is tracked. All Phase 4 MCP server modules and tests are preserved as untracked files. Zero Phase 5 files exist prior to Step 0.

mcp_tool_contracts.name: get_machine_data
mcp_tool_contracts.input_schema: machine_id: str (^M1(0[1-9]|10)$), window: Optional[str], limit: int (1-1000)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: detect_anomaly
mcp_tool_contracts.input_schema: machine_id: str, readings: Optional[list], window: Optional[str], include_explainability: bool
mcp_tool_contracts.output_schema: DetectAnomalyResponse (classification, IF score/threshold, LSTM error/threshold, SHAP/attribution)
mcp_tool_contracts.db_access: sensor_readings in manumind.db if readings omitted
mcp_tool_contracts.mechanism: In-process ML inference in Base Python (<500ms)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: predict_failure_risk
mcp_tool_contracts.special_governance_notice: Formal NOT_AVAILABLE capability stub. Performs zero inference and outputs zero probabilities. Agents must NEVER treat as operational predictor or assume machine is safe.

mcp_tool_contracts.name: search_manuals
mcp_tool_contracts.input_schema: query: str (1-500 chars), k: int (1-20, default 5)
mcp_tool_contracts.output_schema: SearchManualsResponse (results: doc_id, chunk_id, content, cosine_sim, citations, is_synthetic)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: get_maintenance_history
mcp_tool_contracts.output_schema: GetMaintenanceHistoryResponse (records: id, type, action, component, outcome, cost, disclaimer)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: check_defect_image
mcp_tool_contracts.input_schema: image_path: str (Sanitized path or manifest filename)
mcp_tool_contracts.mechanism: Subprocess bridge to Base Python TF runner (120.0s timeout)
assigned_agents: Anomaly Detection Agent (Conditional on image input)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: propose_maintenance_ticket
mcp_tool_contracts.input_schema: machine_id: str, recommendation: str, evidence: dict, alert_id: Optional[str], confidence: float
assigned_agents: Supervisor Agent (Gated; requires confirmed root cause)

mcp_tool_contracts.name: create_maintenance_ticket
mcp_tool_contracts.db_access: Inserts tickets, updates ticket_proposals, inserts consumed_tokens
mcp_tool_contracts.mechanism: Synchronous SQLite transaction with cryptographic verification
assigned_agents: Human Approval Gate Node ONLY (Never autonomously callable by AI agents)

dependency_readiness.hosting_decision: Base Python 3.11.9 must host LangGraph. .venv-rag must remain strictly isolated to preserve Phase 3 lockfile invariants.
dependency_readiness.pydantic_v2_compatibility: Fully compatible. LangGraph >=0.2.0 and LangChain Core >=0.3.0 natively support Pydantic V2.

supervisor_agent.role: Coordinator, Request Validator, Router, and Explainable Synthesizer
supervisor_agent.safety_boundaries: Cannot self-authorize tickets; cannot issue approval tokens; must escalate low confidence (<0.60) to human.

anomaly_detection_agent.role: Telemetry Ingestion, IF/LSTM Scoring, and Defect Classification
anomaly_detection_agent.safety_boundaries: Read-only; distinguishes statistical anomaly from confirmed failure; cannot create tickets.

root_cause_analysis_agent.role: SOP Manual Retrieval, Maintenance Correlation, and Hypothesis Generation
root_cause_analysis_agent.safety_boundaries: Read-only; cannot claim correlation is proven causation; enforces [CIT-X] citations.

human_approval_node.safety_boundaries: Executes strictly when a human engineer supplies an authentic, unexpired, unconsumed HMAC token.

anti_overwrite_rules: Strict slice ownership: Anomaly agent writes anomaly/defect slices; RCA agent writes manual/hypothesis slices; Supervisor writes response/confidence slices.
Append-only reducers (operator.add) for error_details and execution_trace.
Agents are prohibited from nullifying other agents' output slices.

incommensurable_metrics: Isolation Forest score: Contamination score [-0.5, 0.5]; not a probability.
LSTM Reconstruction error: MSE [0, inf); threshold 0.901464; not a failure likelihood.
ResNet Softmax: Class preference [0.0, 1.0]; uncalibrated for physical OOD.
RAG Cosine Similarity: Latent vector proximity [0.60, 1.0]; does not prove physical entailment.
Agent Reasoning Confidence: Epistemic synthesis [0.0, 1.0]; triggers human review.

tiered_rubric.high_confidence_ge_0_80: Anomaly confirmed by IF & LSTM + Defect confirmed + Matching SOP (>=0.70) + Maintenance record.
tiered_rubric.moderate_confidence_0_60_to_0_79: Anomaly confirmed by at least 1 ML model + Matching SOP (>=0.60).
tiered_rubric.low_confidence_lt_0_60: Borderline scores, divergent signals, or RAG similarity < 0.60. Triggers mandatory human review.

escalation_triggers: Anomaly detected but zero RAG chunks retrieved above 0.60.
High-confidence visual defect present without any sensor drift.
Conflicting ML signals (IF anomalous while LSTM normal, or vice versa).

human_approval_workflow.two_stage_workflow: Agent stages proposal via Tool 8 -> Human engineer reviews & signs HMAC token -> Tool 9 validates token & creates ticket.

critical_transaction_integrity_finding.description: create_ticket_with_approval_gate commits ticket at line 67 in ticket_service.py; handle_create_maintenance_ticket commits token consumption at line 931 in tools.py.
critical_transaction_integrity_finding.failure_scenario: Crash between commits leaves ticket created while token remains unconsumed.
critical_transaction_integrity_finding.remediation_requirement: Refactor in Step 7 to execute ticket creation, proposal update, and token consumption inside a single atomic transaction block (with db.begin(): ...).

rag_readiness.citation_format: [CIT-X] linking chunk_id, doc_id, section_title, cosine_similarity, and synthetic flag.
rag_readiness.prompt_injection_defense: Retrieved manuals quarantined inside <manufacturing_manual_context> XML tags; LLM explicitly instructed that context contains untrusted passive data.

failure_handling_matrix.mcp_server_disconnection: Fail closed; abort workflow with MCP_UNAVAILABLE; zero tickets created.
failure_handling_matrix.tool_timeout: Catch TimeoutError; proceed with degraded evidence; apply confidence penalty.
failure_handling_matrix.database_unavailability: Catch OperationalError; abort with DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE; zero partial writes.
failure_handling_matrix.rag_bridge_failure: Catch RAGBridgeProcessError; set retrieved_documents=[]; RCA proceeds with confidence <= 0.45.
failure_handling_matrix.llm_api_outage: Exponential backoff retry (3 attempts); fallback to deterministic rule-based summary.
failure_handling_matrix.malformed_llm_json: Pydantic validation failure triggers 1 formatted retry; fallback to raw text without ticket proposal.
failure_handling_matrix.low_confidence_lt_0_60: System sets requires_human_review=True; refuses autonomous proposal.
failure_handling_matrix.expired_or_replayed_token: Tool 9 rejects with TokenExpiredError or ValueError; zero tickets created.

identified_blockers_and_risks.description: langgraph and langchain_core are not installed in Base Python 3.11.
identified_blockers_and_risks.mitigation: Install pinned dependencies in Base Python during Step 1; verify zero conflicts with mcp==2.3.0.

identified_blockers_and_risks.description: Non-atomic commit between ticket_service and tools.py could leave unconsumed token records.
identified_blockers_and_risks.mitigation: Unify ticket creation and token consumption inside a single with db.begin() block in Step 7.

identified_blockers_and_risks.description: DevelopmentHumanApprovalAdapter uses plaintext PIN dictionary; not integrated with Enterprise SSO.
identified_blockers_and_risks.mitigation: Documented as Production Deployment Blocker; acceptable for Phase 5 development.

identified_blockers_and_risks.description: External LLM API rate limits or network issues could interrupt graph execution.
identified_blockers_and_risks.mitigation: Implement a deterministic mock LLM adapter for offline unit/regression testing.
